End date for the analytics period (inclusive).

ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD) marking the end of the time range for revenue aggregation. All transactions with created_at timestamps on or before this date will be included in the analysis.

Required to define the temporal scope of the revenue report.

grouping.description:
Time-based aggregation granularity for revenue data.

Specifies how revenue metrics should be grouped across the date range:
- daily: One data point per day
- weekly: One data point per week
- monthly: One data point per month
- quarterly: One data point per quarter
- yearly: One data point per year

Optional parameter that enables trend analysis and time-series visualization of revenue performance.

seller_id.description:
Filter revenue statistics to a specific seller.

Optional seller identifier to retrieve revenue metrics for a single merchant rather than platform-wide aggregation. When provided, all revenue metrics will be calculated based solely on transactions involving this seller.

Useful for seller-specific performance analysis and commission reporting.

category_id.description:
Filter revenue statistics to a specific product category.

Optional category identifier to retrieve revenue metrics for a single product category rather than all categories. When provided, only transactions involving products from this category will be included in revenue calculations.

Enables category-level performance analysis and product segment revenue tracking.

IShoppingMallRevenueStatistics.description:
Aggregated revenue statistics and financial metrics for the shopping mall platform.

This schema represents comprehensive financial analytics computed from order transactions, payment records, platform commissions, seller payouts, and refund data across the shopping mall ecosystem.

The statistics provide business intelligence insights for strategic decision-making, financial reporting, and trend analysis. Metrics include gross revenue, net revenue after refunds, platform commission earnings, seller payout amounts, transaction counts, and growth indicators.

This is a computed analytics response that aggregates data from multiple database tables including shopping_mall_orders, shopping_mall_payment_transactions, shopping_mall_platform_commissions, shopping_mall_seller_payouts, and shopping_mall_refund_transactions.

Used exclusively in admin analytics endpoints to provide financial performance visibility to platform administrators.

total_gross_revenue.description:
Total gross revenue generated across all completed orders before any deductions.

This represents the sum of all order totals from shopping_mall_orders table where payment status is completed, providing the top-line revenue figure for the analyzed period.

Calculated by aggregating order_total values from successfully completed transactions.

total_net_revenue.description:
Net revenue after deducting refunds and cancellations.

This metric represents actual revenue retained by the platform after processing all refund requests and order cancellations. Calculated as total_gross_revenue minus total refund amounts from shopping_mall_refund_transactions.

Provides a more accurate picture of actual revenue compared to gross revenue, accounting for customer returns and cancellations.

total_platform_commission.description:
Total commission earnings retained by the platform from seller transactions.

Aggregated from shopping_mall_platform_commissions table, representing the platform's revenue share from facilitating marketplace transactions between sellers and buyers.

This is a key profitability metric indicating platform monetization performance.

total_seller_payouts.description:
Total amount paid out to sellers for their sales.

Sum of all completed payout amounts from shopping_mall_seller_payouts table, representing the total earnings distributed to marketplace sellers.

This metric helps track cash outflow and seller satisfaction by showing how much revenue is being shared with the seller community.

total_refund_amount.description:
Total monetary value of refunds processed to customers.

Aggregated from shopping_mall_refund_transactions table for approved and completed refund requests, indicating customer return rates and potential product quality or satisfaction issues.

High refund amounts may signal operational problems that require investigation.

total_order_count.description:
Total number of orders placed during the analyzed period.

Count of distinct order records from shopping_mall_orders table, providing volume metrics for transaction activity.

Useful for calculating average order values and understanding transaction velocity.

total_transaction_count.description:
Total number of payment transactions processed.

Count of payment transaction records from shopping_mall_payment_transactions table, including successful payments, refunds, and other financial operations.

May differ from order count due to partial payments, installments, or payment method changes.

average_order_value.description:
Average monetary value per order.

Calculated as total_gross_revenue divided by total_order_count, indicating the typical transaction size on the platform.

Key metric for understanding customer purchasing behavior and optimizing pricing strategies.

growth_rate_percentage.description:
Revenue growth rate compared to the previous comparable period.

Expressed as a percentage, showing period-over-period revenue change. Positive values indicate growth, negative values indicate decline.

Null when no previous period data exists for comparison, such as during the first reporting period.

period_start_date.description:
Start date and time of the reporting period for these statistics.

ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating when the analyzed period begins, enabling time-series analysis and trend identification.

Corresponds to the date range filter applied in the request parameters.

period_end_date.description:
End date and time of the reporting period for these statistics.

ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating when the analyzed period concludes.

Defines the boundary of the reporting window used for data aggregation.

IShoppingMallSellerEarningsStatistics.IR.description:
Request parameters for retrieving seller earnings statistics with filtering and aggregation options.

This schema defines the comprehensive search criteria and aggregation preferences for querying seller financial data. It supports temporal filtering, seller-specific analysis, payout status filtering, and configurable time-based aggregation levels.

All filtering parameters are optional, allowing for both broad platform-wide analysis and targeted seller-specific queries.

start_date.description:
Start date for the earnings analysis period (inclusive).

Filters transactions and payouts to include only those occurring on or after this timestamp. When omitted, analysis includes all historical data from platform inception.

ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

end_date.description:
End date for the earnings analysis period (exclusive).

Filters transactions and payouts to include only those occurring before this timestamp. When omitted, analysis includes data up to the current moment.

ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

seller_ids.description:
List of specific seller IDs to include in the analysis.

When provided, statistics are aggregated only for the specified sellers. When omitted, statistics cover all sellers on the platform.

Useful for comparing performance of specific seller cohorts or analyzing individual seller earnings.

payout_status.description:
Filter statistics by payout status.

Allows focusing analysis on specific payout states such as completed payouts only, pending payouts, or failed payout attempts. When omitted, all payout statuses are included in aggregations.

Available values:
- 'completed': Successfully processed and transferred payouts
- 'pending': Payouts awaiting processing
- 'processing': Payouts currently being processed
- 'failed': Payout attempts that failed

aggregation_level.description:
Time-based aggregation granularity for time-series data.

Determines how earnings metrics are grouped in the time_series_data response field. Finer granularities provide more detailed trend analysis but result in larger response payloads.

Available aggregation levels:
- 'daily': One data point per day
- 'weekly': One data point per week  
- 'monthly': One data point per month
- 'yearly': One data point per year

Defaults to 'monthly' when not specified.

include_top_sellers.description:
Whether to include top-performing sellers ranking in the response.

When true, the response includes a top_earning_sellers array with seller-specific earnings summaries ranked by total revenue. When false or omitted, this field is excluded to reduce response size.

Defaults to false.

top_sellers_limit.description:
Number of top sellers to include in the ranking when include_top_sellers is true.

Controls the size of the top_earning_sellers array in the response. Higher limits provide more comprehensive rankings but increase response payload size.

Defaults to 10. Maximum allowed value is 100.

minimum_transaction_count.description:
Minimum number of transactions required for a seller to be included in statistics.

Filters out sellers with low transaction volumes. Useful for focusing analysis on active sellers and excluding new or inactive accounts.

When omitted, all sellers are included regardless of transaction count.

IShoppingMallSellerEarningsStatistics.description:
Aggregated seller earnings statistics providing comprehensive financial metrics and insights.

This schema represents statistical analysis of seller revenue, payouts, and platform commissions across the shopping mall platform. It provides business intelligence data for understanding seller financial performance, payout distributions, and commission trends.

The statistics include multiple aggregation levels supporting daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly analysis. Data encompasses total gross revenue from sales, net earnings after platform commissions, payout metrics including completed and pending amounts, and velocity indicators showing payout processing speed.

This is a computed analytics type that does not map to a single Prisma table. Instead, it represents aggregated query results from shopping_mall_payment_transactions, shopping_mall_seller_payouts, and shopping_mall_platform_commissions tables using GROUP BY operations on time periods and seller dimensions.

Used exclusively in administrative statistical analysis operations to provide financial insights and performance tracking capabilities.

total_gross_revenue.description:
Total gross revenue generated by sellers before platform commission deductions.

Represents the sum of all successful payment transactions associated with seller products during the analyzed period. This metric provides insight into overall marketplace transaction volume and seller sales performance.

Calculated by aggregating payment_transactions.amount where transaction status is completed.

total_net_revenue.description:
Total net revenue retained by sellers after platform commission deductions.

Represents the actual earnings that sellers receive after the platform takes its commission percentage. This is the amount available for seller payout processing.

Calculated as total_gross_revenue minus total_platform_commissions.

total_platform_commissions.description:
Total platform commission amount deducted from seller earnings.

Represents the platform's revenue from facilitating seller transactions. Commission rates may vary by seller tier, product category, or promotional periods.

Calculated by aggregating platform_commissions.commission_amount for the analyzed period.

total_payouts_completed.description:
Total amount of seller payouts that have been successfully completed and transferred.

Represents the sum of all payout transactions that reached 'completed' status, indicating funds were successfully transferred to seller bank accounts.

Calculated by aggregating seller_payouts.payout_amount where status is 'completed'.

total_payouts_pending.description:
Total amount of seller payouts currently pending processing or approval.

Represents earnings that are scheduled for payout but have not yet been transferred to sellers. This may include payouts awaiting approval, processing, or within holding periods.

Calculated by aggregating seller_payouts.payout_amount where status is 'pending' or 'processing'.

average_payout_amount.description:
Average payout amount per transaction across all completed seller payouts.

Provides insight into typical payout sizes, which can inform cash flow planning and payout scheduling policies.

Calculated as total_payouts_completed divided by count of completed payout transactions.

payout_count_completed.description:
Total number of completed payout transactions.

Indicates how many individual payout operations were successfully processed during the analyzed period. Higher counts may indicate more frequent payout schedules or smaller payout amounts.

payout_count_pending.description:
Total number of pending payout transactions awaiting processing.

Indicates the current backlog of payout operations that need to be completed. High values may signal processing delays or holding period policies.

average_commission_rate.description:
Average platform commission rate as a percentage of gross revenue.

Calculated as (total_platform_commissions / total_gross_revenue) * 100. This metric helps analyze effective commission rates across different seller tiers and product categories.

Expressed as a percentage value between 0 and 100.

seller_count.description:
Total number of unique sellers included in this statistical aggregation.

Provides context for the scale of the analyzed data set. When filtered by specific sellers, this may be 1 or a smaller subset.

time_series_data.description:
Time-series breakdown of earnings metrics by aggregation period.

Provides temporal analysis of earnings trends, enabling identification of growth patterns, seasonal variations, and performance changes over time.

Each data point represents aggregated metrics for a specific time period (day, week, month, or year) based on the request aggregation level.

top_earning_sellers.description:
List of top-performing sellers ranked by total earnings.

Provides insight into which sellers generate the most revenue on the platform. Useful for identifying high-value sellers and understanding revenue concentration.

Typically limited to top 10-20 sellers to maintain response size efficiency.

IShoppingMallSellerEarningsTimeSeriesDat.description:
Single time-series data point representing earnings metrics for a specific time period.

Each data point aggregates seller earnings statistics for one time bucket (day, week, month, quarter, or year) within the overall analysis period. This enables trend analysis and temporal pattern identification in seller financial performance.

The granularity of time periods is determined by the aggregation_period parameter in the request (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly).

This structure provides temporal breakdown of aggregate metrics, enabling period-over-period comparisons and visualization of earnings patterns over time.

period_start.description:
Start timestamp of this aggregation period.

Represents the beginning of the time bucket for which metrics are aggregated. For daily aggregation this is midnight of the day, for weekly it's the start of the week, etc.

ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

period_end.description:
End timestamp of this aggregation period.

Represents the end of the time bucket for which metrics are aggregated. This is exclusive (metrics include transactions before but not at this timestamp).

ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

gross_earnings.description:
Total gross seller earnings for this time period before commission deductions.

Aggregated sum of all successful payment transactions attributed to sellers within the period.

Represents the top-line revenue generated by sellers during this period.

net_earnings.description:
Total net seller earnings for this time period after commission deductions.

Calculated as gross_earnings minus platform_commission for this time bucket.

Represents actual seller revenue available for payout during this period.

platform_commission.description:
Total platform commission amount collected during this time period.

Sum of commission amounts retained by the platform from seller transactions within this time bucket.

Indicates platform revenue generation for this specific period.

payout_amount.description:
Total amount paid out to sellers during this time period.

Sum of all completed payout transactions processed within this time bucket.

Shows actual cash outflow to sellers for this period, which may differ from earnings due to payout processing schedules.

transaction_count.description:
Number of individual payment transactions within this time period.

Count of distinct payment transaction records within this time bucket.

Provides volume metrics to understand transaction activity levels over time.

active_seller_count.description:
Number of unique sellers who generated earnings during this time period.

Count of distinct seller IDs with transactions in this time bucket.

Indicates seller engagement and marketplace activity levels for the period.

IShoppingMallSellerEarningsSummary.description:
Summary of earnings for an individual seller within the statistical analysis period.

Provides seller-specific financial metrics including total revenue, commission amounts, and payout status. Used in top sellers rankings and seller performance comparisons.

seller_id.description:
Unique identifier of the seller.

References the shopping_mall_sellers.id field.

seller_name.description:
Display name of the seller.

Provides human-readable seller identification in statistical reports.

gross_revenue.description:
Total gross revenue generated by this seller during the analysis period.

Sum of all successful payment transactions for the seller's products.

net_revenue.description:
Total net revenue retained by this seller after commission deductions.

Represents the seller's actual earnings from sales.

platform_commissions.description:
Total platform commission amount deducted from this seller's earnings.

Sum of all commission charges for the seller's transactions.

transaction_count.description:
Number of successful payment transactions for this seller.

Provides volume metrics alongside revenue amounts.

average_transaction_value.description:
Average gross revenue per transaction for this seller.

Calculated as gross_revenue divided by transaction_count. Indicates typical order sizes.

IShoppingMallReview.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and filtering product reviews with pagination and sorting.

This schema defines comprehensive search criteria for querying product reviews across the shopping mall platform. It supports filtering by product, seller, buyer, SKU variant, rating values, moderation status, verification status, anonymity, date ranges, and text search. The request enables both broad marketplace-wide review browsing and targeted product-specific or seller-specific review retrieval.

All parameters are optional, allowing flexible query construction from simple list retrieval to complex multi-criteria searches.

page.description:
Page number for pagination (1-indexed).

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Must be a positive integer starting from 1.

Defaults to 1 when not specified.

limit.description:
Number of review items per page.

Controls the page size for pagination. Higher limits reduce the number of requests needed but increase response payload size and processing time.

Defaults to 20. Maximum allowed value is 100 to prevent excessive data transfer.

sale_id.description:
Filter reviews by specific product sale ID.

When provided, returns only reviews associated with the specified product listing. This parameter is typically used when retrieving reviews for a product detail page.

References shopping_mall_sales.id in the Prisma schema.

sku_id.description:
Filter reviews by specific product SKU variant.

When provided, returns only reviews associated with the specified SKU variant of a product. This parameter is useful when products have multiple variants (different colors, sizes, configurations) and you want to see reviews specific to one variant.

References shopping_mall_sale_skus.id in the Prisma schema via shopping_mall_reviews.shopping_mall_sale_sku_id.

seller_id.description:
Filter reviews by seller ID to show reviews for all products from a specific seller.

IMPORTANT: The shopping_mall_reviews table does not have a direct foreign key to sellers. This filter requires joining through the shopping_mall_sales table: reviews.sale.seller_id = {seller_id}.

References shopping_mall_sellers.id indirectly through the sales relationship.

buyer_id.description:
Filter reviews by buyer ID to show all reviews written by a specific buyer.

Used for buyer profile pages and review management interfaces where users view their own review history.

References shopping_mall_buyers.id in the Prisma schema via shopping_mall_reviews.shopping_mall_buyer_id.

status.description:
Filter reviews by moderation status.

Valid values: pending_moderation, approved, rejected. This filter is essential for admin moderation workflows to review pending submissions, audit approved reviews, or analyze rejected content.

When omitted, behavior depends on user role: public users see only approved reviews, while administrators can see all statuses. Corresponds to shopping_mall_reviews.status field in the Prisma schema.

min_rating.description:
Minimum star rating filter (inclusive).

Filters reviews to include only those with ratings greater than or equal to this value. Useful for filtering positive reviews (e.g., 4+ stars) or excluding very low ratings.

Rating values range from 1 to 5 stars.

max_rating.description:
Maximum star rating filter (inclusive).

Filters reviews to include only those with ratings less than or equal to this value. Useful for analyzing negative feedback by filtering low-rating reviews.

Rating values range from 1 to 5 stars. Must be greater than or equal to min_rating when both are specified.

verified_purchase_only.description:
Filter to show only reviews from verified purchases.

When true, returns only reviews where the buyer has a confirmed purchase of the product. This helps users focus on authentic feedback from actual customers.

Defaults to false, including all reviews regardless of verification status.

is_anonymous.description:
Filter reviews by anonymity status.

When true, returns only reviews submitted anonymously (where reviewer name displays as Anonymous Buyer). When false, returns only reviews with buyer attribution. When omitted, includes all reviews regardless of anonymity.

Corresponds to shopping_mall_reviews.is_anonymous field in the Prisma schema. Useful for analyzing review attribution patterns and understanding privacy preferences.

start_date.description:
Filter reviews created on or after this date (inclusive).

Enables temporal filtering to analyze recent feedback or compare reviews across different time periods. When omitted, includes reviews from all historical dates.

ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

end_date.description:
Filter reviews created before this date (exclusive).

Enables temporal filtering to analyze feedback within specific time windows. When omitted, includes reviews up to the current moment.

ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

search_text.description:
Full-text search query for review content and titles.

Searches within review text content to find reviews mentioning specific keywords, product features, or concerns. Enables buyers to find reviews discussing particular aspects of products.

Implementation should support case-insensitive partial matching.

oneOf.description:
Field to sort results by.

Determines the ordering criteria for review results:
- 'created_at': Sort by review submission date (chronological)
- 'rating': Sort by star rating value
- 'helpfulness': Sort by number of helpfulness votes from other users

Defaults to 'created_at' when not specified.

Field to sort results by.

Determines the ordering criteria for review results:
- 'created_at': Sort by review submission date (chronological)
- 'rating': Sort by star rating value
- 'helpfulness': Sort by number of helpfulness votes from other users

Defaults to 'created_at' when not specified.

Field to sort results by.

Determines the ordering criteria for review results:
- 'created_at': Sort by review submission date (chronological)
- 'rating': Sort by star rating value
- 'helpfulness': Sort by number of helpfulness votes from other users

Defaults to 'created_at' when not specified.

sort_by.description:
Field to sort results by.

Determines the ordering criteria for review results:
- 'created_at': Sort by review submission date (chronological)
- 'rating': Sort by star rating value
- 'helpfulness': Sort by number of helpfulness votes from other users

Defaults to 'created_at' when not specified.

oneOf.description:
Sort direction for the specified sort_by field.

- 'asc': Ascending order (oldest first for dates, lowest rating first, least helpful first)
- 'desc': Descending order (newest first for dates, highest rating first, most helpful first)

Defaults to 'desc' to show most recent, highest-rated, or most helpful reviews first.

Sort direction for the specified sort_by field.

- 'asc': Ascending order (oldest first for dates, lowest rating first, least helpful first)
- 'desc': Descending order (newest first for dates, highest rating first, most helpful first)

Defaults to 'desc' to show most recent, highest-rated, or most helpful reviews first.

sort_order.description:
Sort direction for the specified sort_by field.

- 'asc': Ascending order (oldest first for dates, lowest rating first, least helpful first)
- 'desc': Descending order (newest first for dates, highest rating first, most helpful first)

Defaults to 'desc' to show most recent, highest-rated, or most helpful reviews first.

has_seller_response.description:
Filter reviews based on whether sellers have responded.

When true, returns only reviews that have seller responses. When false, returns only reviews without seller responses. When omitted, includes all reviews regardless of seller response status.

Useful for sellers to identify unanswered reviews that need attention.

has_images.description:
Filter reviews based on whether they include customer-uploaded images.

When true, returns only reviews with attached images. Image-containing reviews often provide more detailed product feedback and visual evidence.

Defaults to false, including all reviews regardless of image presence.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the review record.

This UUID serves as the primary key for tracking individual product reviews in the marketplace. Corresponds to the id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table.

shopping_mall_buyer_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the buyer who submitted this review.

Links this review to the authenticated buyer account that authored the review. Corresponds to the shopping_mall_buyer_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_buyers.id.

This field is essential for ownership verification, enabling buyers to edit or delete their own reviews. It also supports buyer-specific review filtering and helps establish review attribution and accountability in the moderation workflow.

shopping_mall_sale_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the product sale being reviewed.

Links this review to the base product listing in the marketplace. Corresponds to the shopping_mall_sale_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_sales.id.

This field enables product-level review aggregation and filtering. It allows the system to calculate aggregate ratings for products and display all reviews for a specific product listing across all its variants.

shopping_mall_sale_sku_id.description:
Reference to the specific product SKU variant that was reviewed.

Links this review to the exact product configuration (color, size, options) that the buyer purchased and evaluated. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_sale_skus.id. Enables variant-specific review filtering and helps buyers assess specific product configurations.

shopping_mall_order_id.description:
Reference to the order that verifies the purchase for authenticity.

Links this review to the actual purchase transaction used for verified purchase validation. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_orders.id. Critical for maintaining review credibility and ensuring only actual purchasers can submit reviews.

buyer.description:
Summary information about the buyer who submitted this review.

Provides essential context about the reviewer including their identity and verification status, enabling review authenticity assessment. Contains buyer identification for attribution and credibility.

sale.description:
Summary information about the product being reviewed.

Provides context about which product this review pertains to, including product name, category, and key identifiers. Enables navigation to the product detail page from the review and helps users understand the review context.

star_rating.description:
Star rating from 1 to 5 stars given by the buyer.

Numeric score representing buyer satisfaction level with the product. Required field where 1 represents the lowest rating and 5 represents the highest. Used for calculating aggregate product ratings and influencing product rankings.

review_title.description:
Optional review title or summary.

Brief headline summarizing the buyer's opinion. Maximum 100 characters when provided. Provides quick overview of review content and helps other buyers quickly understand the key message. May be null if buyer chose not to provide a title.

review_body.description:
Detailed review text content.

Contains substantive buyer feedback about product quality, features, and experience. Minimum 10 characters when provided, maximum 5000 characters. May be null if buyer only provided a star rating without detailed commentary.

oneOf.description: Review is awaiting admin approval before public display.
Review has been approved and is publicly visible.
Review was rejected for policy violations and is not publicly visible.

status.description:
Review moderation status.

Determines public visibility and whether the review appears in product listings and rating calculations. Reviews enter pending_moderation status upon submission and require admin approval before becoming publicly visible.

is_verified_purchase.description:
Whether this review is from a verified purchase.

True when buyer purchased the product through the platform and order was delivered successfully. False for reviews that cannot be verified against purchase records. Verified purchase badge enhances review credibility and trustworthiness.

is_anonymous.description:
Whether buyer chose to submit review anonymously.

When true, reviewer name displays as Anonymous Buyer instead of actual name in public review displays. Allows buyers to provide honest feedback without public attribution. Does not affect internal tracking and moderation workflows.

helpfulness_vote_count.description:
Total count of helpful votes from other buyers.

Aggregate count tracking how many buyers found this review useful. Used for Most Helpful sorting algorithm and highlighting high-quality reviews. Incremented when buyers vote review as helpful, never decremented.

created_at.description:
Review submission timestamp.

Records when buyer initially submitted the review. ISO 8601 format with timezone information. Used for sorting reviews by recency and tracking review submission patterns.

updated_at.description:
Last modification timestamp.

Tracks when the review content, rating, or images were last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone information. Automatically updated by the system whenever modifications are made. Used for tracking edit history and review freshness.

deleted_at.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.

Set when buyer or admin deletes the review. Null for active reviews. When set, review is excluded from public display and rating calculations while preserving historical data for audit purposes.

IShoppingMallReview.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of product reviews for list views and embedded contexts.

Provides essential review information optimized for displaying in product listing pages, review feeds, and buyer dashboards. This lightweight DTO includes all critical review metadata including moderation status, verification badges, and helpfulness metrics.

Used in product detail pages showing recent reviews, buyer profile pages showing their review history, and search results where review snippets provide social proof. The summary excludes detailed relationship data to optimize list rendering performance while maintaining sufficient context for display.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the product review.

Primary key for the review record in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Used for referencing specific reviews in operations and establishing relationships with images, votes, and moderation logs.

shopping_mall_buyer_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the buyer who submitted this review.

Links this review to the authenticated buyer account that created the review. Corresponds to the shopping_mall_buyer_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_buyers.id.

This field establishes the review ownership relationship, enabling the system to verify that only the original author can update or delete the review. It also supports querying all reviews written by a specific buyer and maintains accountability in the review moderation workflow. The buyer information is also exposed through the `buyer` object reference for convenient access to full buyer details.

shopping_mall_sale_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the product sale being reviewed.

Links this review to the base product listing in the marketplace. Corresponds to the shopping_mall_sale_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_sales.id.

This field enables product-level review aggregation, allowing the system to calculate aggregate ratings and display all reviews for a specific product across its variants. It supports product detail pages showing review counts and average ratings. The product information is also exposed through the `sale` object reference for complete product context.

shopping_mall_sale_sku_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the specific product SKU variant being reviewed.

Links this review to the exact product configuration (color, size, options) that the buyer purchased and evaluated. Corresponds to the shopping_mall_sale_sku_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_sale_skus.id.

This field enables variant-specific review filtering, helping buyers find reviews for their intended variant configuration. It ensures reviews are attributed to the correct product variant since different SKUs may have different characteristics affecting satisfaction. The SKU information is also exposed through the `sku` object reference for complete variant details.

shopping_mall_order_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the order that verifies the purchase for authenticity.

Links this review to the actual purchase transaction used for verified purchase validation. Corresponds to the shopping_mall_order_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_orders.id.

This field is critical for maintaining review credibility by proving the reviewer actually purchased the product through the platform. It enforces the one-review-per-purchase business rule through the unique index on buyer_id + order_id + sale_sku_id. The order information is also exposed through the `order` object reference to show purchase verification context.

buyer.description:
Summary information about the buyer who submitted this review.

Provides essential buyer context including name, email, and verification status. Transformed from shopping_mall_buyer_id foreign key to provide complete reviewer information in a single API call. Used for review attribution, credibility assessment, and trust signals.

sale.description:
Summary information about the product being reviewed.

Provides complete product context including name, category, seller, and key identifiers. Transformed from shopping_mall_sale_id foreign key to enable full product understanding without additional API calls. Facilitates navigation to product detail page and helps users assess review relevance.

sku.description:
Summary information about the specific product variant being reviewed.

Provides details about the exact product configuration (color, size, options) that the buyer purchased and is evaluating. Transformed from shopping_mall_sale_sku_id foreign key to give buyers variant-specific context. Helps potential buyers assess whether reviews match their intended purchase configuration.

order.description:
Summary information about the verified purchase order.

Provides order context that validates this review's authenticity as a verified purchase. Transformed from shopping_mall_order_id foreign key to show purchase verification details. Enhances review credibility by linking to actual transaction.

star_rating.description:
Product rating score from 1 to 5 stars.

Represents the buyer's satisfaction level with the purchased product. Required field where 1 is the lowest rating and 5 is the highest. This rating contributes to the product's aggregate rating statistics and influences product rankings in search and discovery algorithms.

review_title.description:
Optional review title or summary.

Brief headline summarizing the buyer's opinion. Maximum 100 characters when provided. Provides quick overview of review content that appears prominently in review listings. Helps other buyers quickly understand the key message. May be null if buyer chose not to provide a title.

review_body.description:
Detailed review text content.

Contains substantive buyer feedback about product quality, features, and experience. Minimum 10 characters when provided, maximum 5000 characters. This detailed information helps other buyers make informed purchasing decisions. May be null if buyer only provided star rating without detailed commentary.

oneOf.description: Review is awaiting admin approval before public display.
Review has been approved and is publicly visible.
Review was rejected for policy violations and is not publicly visible.

status.description:
Review moderation status.

Determines public visibility of the review. Reviews enter pending_moderation status upon submission, require admin approval to become approved and publicly visible, or can be rejected for policy violations. Only approved reviews appear in public product listings and rating calculations.

is_verified_purchase.description:
Whether this review is from a verified purchase.

True when buyer purchased the product through the platform and order was delivered successfully. False for reviews that cannot be verified against purchase records. Verified purchase badge is displayed to buyers to indicate authentic reviews and enhance credibility.

is_anonymous.description:
Whether buyer chose to submit review anonymously.

When true, reviewer name displays as Anonymous Buyer instead of actual name in public displays. Allows buyers to provide honest feedback without public attribution while maintaining internal tracking for moderation and support purposes.

helpfulness_vote_count.description:
Total count of helpful votes from other buyers.

Aggregate count tracking how many other buyers found this review useful. Used for Most Helpful sorting algorithm to surface high-quality reviews. Incremented when buyers vote review as helpful, providing social validation of review quality.

images.description:
Array of images uploaded by the buyer to accompany their review.

Visual evidence supporting the review content. Buyers can upload up to 5 images showing actual product received, packaging, or specific features. Images help other buyers assess product quality and verify product descriptions, enhancing review usefulness.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the review was originally created.

Records when the buyer first submitted this review. Displayed in ISO 8601 format with timezone information. Used for sorting reviews by recency and tracking review submission patterns over time.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the review was last modified.

Tracks the most recent update to the review content, rating, or images. Displayed in ISO 8601 format with timezone information. Automatically updated by the system whenever any modification is made to the review. Used for tracking edit history and review freshness.

deleted_at.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.

Set when buyer or admin deletes the review. Null for active reviews that are currently visible. When set, the review is logically deleted and excluded from public display and rating calculations while preserving historical data for audit purposes and preventing re-submission.

IShoppingMallReview.description:
Complete product review entity with full details.

Represents a product review submitted by an authenticated buyer who purchased the product. Reviews include star rating, optional title and detailed content, images, moderation status, verification flags, and helpfulness metrics that help other buyers make informed purchasing decisions.

This entity corresponds to the shopping_mall_reviews table in the Prisma schema. Reviews are created only by verified purchasers and can be updated by the original author. The review contributes to the product's aggregate rating statistics and influences product discovery and rankings.

Reviews require admin moderation approval before becoming publicly visible, ensuring platform content quality and policy compliance. The entity tracks complete review lifecycle including submission, updates, moderation decisions, and soft deletion.

All foreign key relationships have been transformed to object references using .ISummary pattern to enable complete information retrieval in a single API call, following the atomic operation principle and foreign key elimination principle.

shopping_mall_sale_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the product sale being reviewed.

This identifies which product listing the buyer is reviewing, corresponding to the shopping_mall_sale_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. The sale must exist in the shopping_mall_sales table and must be associated with an order that the authenticated buyer has received.

The system validates that this sale ID is valid and that the buyer has a verified purchase of this product through the order validation process.

shopping_mall_sale_sku_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the specific product SKU variant being reviewed.

This identifies the exact product variant (with specific color, size, or other attributes) that the buyer purchased and is reviewing, corresponding to the shopping_mall_sale_sku_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. The SKU must belong to the specified sale and must match the SKU in the buyer's order.

This field is required to ensure reviews are attributed to the correct product variant, as different SKUs of the same product may have different characteristics that affect buyer satisfaction.

shopping_mall_order_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the order that verifies the purchase for verified purchase validation.

This links the review to the actual purchase transaction, corresponding to the shopping_mall_order_id column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. The order must belong to the authenticated buyer and must be in a delivered or completed status to enable review submission.

This field enables the platform to verify that the reviewer actually purchased the product, ensuring review authenticity and preventing fake reviews from non-purchasers.

star_rating.description:
Star rating from 1 to 5 stars representing buyer satisfaction.

This is the buyer's overall satisfaction rating where 1 represents the lowest rating and 5 represents the highest, corresponding to the star_rating column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. This is a required field that must be an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive.

The rating contributes to the product's aggregate rating statistics and influences product rankings in search results and category browsing. Each rating level represents a distinct satisfaction tier that helps other buyers gauge product quality.

review_title.description:
Optional review title or summary providing a quick overview.

This brief headline summarizes the buyer's opinion in a concise phrase, corresponding to the review_title column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Maximum length is 100 characters as defined in the Prisma schema.

The title appears prominently in review listings and helps other buyers quickly understand the main point of the review. While optional, providing a descriptive title improves review usefulness and engagement.

review_body.description:
Detailed review text content describing the buyer's experience.

This is the main body of the review where the buyer provides comprehensive feedback about product quality, features, performance, and value, corresponding to the review_body column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. When provided, content must be between 10 and 5000 characters as defined in the Prisma schema.

Substantive review content helps other buyers make informed purchasing decisions by sharing real-world experiences, observations, and product assessments. The minimum length ensures reviews provide meaningful information rather than generic comments.

is_anonymous.description:
Whether the buyer chooses to submit the review anonymously.

When true, the reviewer's name displays as "Anonymous Buyer" instead of their actual name in public review displays, corresponding to the is_anonymous column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. This allows buyers to share honest feedback while maintaining privacy.

Anonymous reviews are still linked to verified purchases and maintain the same credibility indicators, but the buyer's identity is hidden from public view. The platform still tracks the actual reviewer for moderation and accountability purposes.

images.description:
Optional array of product images uploaded by the buyer to support the review.

Buyers can include photos showing the actual product received, packaging, specific features, or any aspects mentioned in their review. Images enhance review credibility by providing visual evidence and help other buyers assess product quality and accuracy.

Each image in the array will be stored in the shopping_mall_review_images table with references to the parent review. The platform enforces limits on the number of images per review and validates image format, size, and content compliance.

IShoppingMallReview.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new product review by authenticated buyers.

This type defines the information a buyer must provide when submitting a review for a purchased product, corresponding to the shopping_mall_reviews table in the Prisma schema. The buyer's identity (shopping_mall_buyer_id) is automatically extracted from the JWT authentication token and does not need to be included in the request.

Business rules enforced during review creation include verified purchase validation (buyer must have actually purchased and received the product), one review per purchase limitation (enforced by unique index on buyer_id + order_id + sale_sku_id), content policy compliance, and automatic pending status assignment for moderation. The system validates that the specified order belongs to the authenticated buyer and that the order is in a delivered or completed status.

Reviews enter pending_moderation status upon creation and become publicly visible only after admin approval. The is_verified_purchase field is automatically set to true when all purchase validation checks pass.

star_rating.description:
Product rating score from 1 to 5 stars representing buyer satisfaction.

This is the buyer's overall satisfaction rating where 1 represents the lowest rating and 5 represents the highest, corresponding to the star_rating column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. The rating must be an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive.

Updating the rating will affect the product's aggregate rating statistics and may influence product rankings. Each rating level represents a distinct satisfaction tier that buyers use to express their product experience and guide other potential purchasers.

review_title.description:
Brief review headline summarizing the buyer's opinion.

This optional field provides a concise summary of the review content, corresponding to the review_title column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. Maximum length is 100 characters as defined in the Prisma schema.

The title appears prominently in review listings and search results, helping other buyers quickly understand the key message. The platform may moderate titles that violate content guidelines or contain inappropriate language.

review_body.description:
Detailed review text describing the buyer's experience with the product.

This optional field contains the main body of the review where buyers share their detailed opinions, experiences, and observations about the purchased product, corresponding to the review_body column in the shopping_mall_reviews table. When provided, content must be between 10 and 5000 characters as defined in the Prisma schema.

Substantive review content helps other potential buyers make informed purchasing decisions by providing real-world experiences and product assessments. Content is subject to platform moderation guidelines and may be reviewed for policy violations.

images.description:
Array of product images to update for the review.

Visual evidence supporting the review content, allowing buyers to share actual photos of the product they received. Images help other buyers assess product quality and verify product description accuracy.

Each image must follow the platform's upload requirements including file format, size limits, and content guidelines. The platform may limit the total number of images per review and apply content moderation to ensure compliance with community standards. Updating this array replaces the existing images associated with the review.

IShoppingMallReview.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema for updating an existing product review by authenticated buyers.

This DTO represents the modifiable fields of a product review that buyers can update after initial submission, corresponding to the shopping_mall_reviews table in the Prisma schema. All fields are optional to support partial updates - buyers can modify only the specific aspects they wish to change without resubmitting the entire review.

The update operation validates that the review belongs to the authenticated buyer making the request. Only the original review author can perform updates, and reviews must be in a modifiable state (not deleted or permanently rejected). The system automatically updates the updated_at timestamp when any modification is made.

Updated reviews may be subject to re-moderation if significant changes are made to content or images. Moderation status may revert to pending_moderation if the changes are substantial, requiring admin review before the updated content becomes publicly visible again.

IShoppingMallReviewImage.description:
Product review image entity representing visual evidence uploaded by verified buyers to supplement their product reviews.

This entity captures image uploads that buyers attach to their product reviews, providing visual proof of their purchase experience. Each image is associated with a specific review and includes metadata about upload timing, display ordering, and processing status across multiple size variants.

Review images are stored in three different sizes to optimize display performance across different contexts: original high-resolution for detailed viewing, medium-sized for lightbox previews, and thumbnails for efficient list rendering. All three URLs are generated during the upload process and stored together.

Review images enhance the credibility and usefulness of product reviews by allowing potential buyers to see actual product photos from verified purchasers. Images are subject to moderation to ensure compliance with platform content policies.

The entity maintains relationships with reviews (parent), buyers (uploader), and moderation logs (audit trail). Images are stored in the platform's media storage system with URLs referenced in this entity.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the review image record.

System-generated UUID that serves as the primary key for this image entity. Used for referencing specific images in API operations, moderation workflows, and display ordering.

shopping_mall_review_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the parent product review.

Links this image to the specific review it belongs to. Ensures images are displayed in the context of their associated review and enables cascading operations when reviews are deleted or moderated.

image_url.description:
URL path to the uploaded review image in its original high-resolution format.

Points to the original high-resolution image stored in the platform's media storage system. This version is typically hosted on CDN infrastructure for optimal delivery performance and is used for full-size image viewing and detailed examination.

The URL is permanent and should remain accessible as long as the review exists and is approved. This is the highest quality version of the image, suitable for zoomed or detailed viewing contexts.

thumbnail_url.description:
URL path to the generated thumbnail version of the review image.

Points to a 200x200 pixel thumbnail variant automatically generated during image upload. This size is optimized for efficient display in review lists, product detail page review galleries, and mobile interfaces where bandwidth efficiency is critical.

Thumbnails are processed and stored alongside the original image, providing fast-loading preview images that maintain acceptable visual quality while minimizing data transfer. Used extensively in list views and grid layouts.

medium_url.description:
URL path to the medium-sized version of the review image.

Points to an 800x800 pixel medium-resolution variant generated during upload processing. This size is optimized for lightbox preview displays, modal views, and tablet interfaces where a balance between quality and loading speed is needed.

The medium size provides sufficient detail for most viewing contexts without the bandwidth cost of the full-resolution original. Commonly used in interactive image galleries and preview overlays.

display_order.description:
Sequential position of this image within the review's image gallery.

Determines the display order when showing multiple images for a single review. Lower numbers appear first. Allows reviewers to control which images are most prominent in their review presentation and establish a visual narrative sequence.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the image was uploaded to the review.

Records the exact moment the image was added to the platform. Used for audit trails, sorting recent images, and tracking review enhancement activities over time. Immutable once set during creation.

IShoppingMallReviewImage.ICreate.description:
Request body for uploading a new image to an existing product review.

This DTO captures the data required when a verified buyer uploads additional visual evidence to supplement their product review. The operation validates that the review exists and belongs to the authenticated buyer before accepting the image upload.

The image file must be pre-uploaded to the storage system and processed into three size variants (original, medium, thumbnail) before submitting this request. The DTO receives all three resulting URLs along with display ordering information. File validation, size limits, format restrictions, and image processing occur during the upload phase before this DTO is submitted.

Security considerations ensure that only the review author can add images to their own reviews, and that image URLs point to valid, moderated storage locations. The buyer's identity is derived from the authentication context and must match the review's author.

image_url.description:
Pre-uploaded original high-resolution image URL from the media storage system.

The original image file must be uploaded to the platform's storage service before submitting this request. The URL should be a valid, accessible path to the stored original-quality image file. The system validates that the URL points to an approved storage location and that the file meets platform requirements for format and size.

This is the highest quality version of the image, used for detailed viewing and as the source for generating other size variants if needed in the future.

thumbnail_url.description:
Pre-generated thumbnail image URL (200x200 pixels) from the media storage system.

The thumbnail variant must be generated and uploaded during the image processing phase before submitting this request. This size-optimized version is used for efficient display in review lists and mobile interfaces.

The system validates that this URL points to a valid thumbnail image in approved storage and that it corresponds to the same image as the original URL.

medium_url.description:
Pre-generated medium-sized image URL (800x800 pixels) from the media storage system.

The medium variant must be generated and uploaded during the image processing phase before submitting this request. This balanced-quality version is used for lightbox previews and modal displays.

The system validates that this URL points to a valid medium-sized image in approved storage and that it corresponds to the same image as the original URL.

display_order.description:
Display position of this image within the review's image gallery.

Specifies where this image should appear in the sequence of review images. Lower numbers display first. If not specified, the image is appended to the end of the existing image sequence. Allows reviewers to control the visual narrative of their review.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the seller response.

This UUID serves as the primary key for the seller response record in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses table. It is automatically generated by the system upon response creation and remains immutable throughout the response's lifecycle.

The identifier enables precise referencing of specific seller responses in update and delete operations, and supports tracking of seller engagement with customer reviews across the marketplace platform.

Corresponds to the id column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

shopping_mall_review_id.description:
Review that this response belongs to.

This foreign key establishes the relationship between the seller response and the customer review it addresses. References the shopping_mall_reviews.id column in the Prisma schema.

The system enforces a unique constraint on this field, ensuring that each review can have at most one seller response. This prevents duplicate or conflicting responses from appearing on the same review.

Corresponds to the shopping_mall_review_id column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description:
Seller who submitted the response.

This foreign key references the shopping_mall_sellers.id column and identifies which merchant authored this response. The seller must be the owner of the product that was reviewed, ensuring authenticity and preventing sellers from responding to reviews on competitors' products.

This field is automatically populated from the authenticated seller's JWT token during response creation, eliminating the possibility of seller impersonation or unauthorized responses.

Corresponds to the shopping_mall_seller_id column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

response_body.description:
Seller response text content.

Contains seller's reply to buyer feedback including explanations, apologies, or solutions offered. This field contains the seller's written reply addressing the customer's feedback, concerns, or praise expressed in the product review.

The response text should be professional, courteous, and focused on addressing the specific points raised in the customer's review. It serves as public communication visible to all marketplace users and reflects on the seller's customer service quality and professionalism.

Minimum 10 characters, maximum 2000 characters. The system may enforce character limits and content validation to maintain response quality and prevent abuse.

Corresponds to the response_body column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

status.description:
Response moderation status.

Valid values: pending_moderation, approved, rejected. Controls public visibility of the seller response.

Responses in pending_moderation status are awaiting review by platform moderators and are not visible to buyers. Approved responses are publicly displayed alongside their associated reviews. Rejected responses have been removed due to policy violations and are hidden from public view.

The moderation workflow ensures that seller responses maintain professional standards and comply with marketplace guidelines.

Corresponds to the status column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

created_at.description:
Response submission timestamp.

Recorded when seller initially submits the response. This ISO 8601 formatted datetime indicates when the seller first created their response to the customer review.

It is automatically set by the system upon response creation and remains immutable, providing a permanent audit trail of when sellers engaged with customer feedback. The timestamp is displayed to buyers to show how promptly sellers respond to reviews.

Corresponds to the created_at column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

updated_at.description:
Last modification timestamp.

Updated when seller edits response or admin moderates it. This ISO 8601 formatted datetime tracks the most recent update to the seller response content or moderation status.

It is automatically updated by the system whenever the seller edits their response text or when administrators perform moderation actions, allowing buyers to see if and when a response was revised.

Corresponds to the updated_at column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

deleted_at.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.

Set when seller deletes their response or system auto-removes due to review edit. Deleted responses are excluded from public display but retained in the database for audit purposes.

When a buyer edits their original review, any associated seller response is automatically soft-deleted to maintain contextual accuracy, as the seller's response may no longer be relevant to the updated review content. Sellers must submit fresh responses to edited review content.

Corresponds to the deleted_at column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

IShoppingMallReviewSellerResponse.description:
Seller response to a product review in the shopping marketplace.

This entity represents a seller's official reply to a customer review on their product. Seller responses enable merchants to engage with buyer feedback by posting public replies that address customer concerns, provide clarifications, express gratitude for positive reviews, or offer solutions to problems raised in reviews.

Each review can have at most one seller response to maintain clarity and prevent spam. Only the seller whose product was reviewed can post a response, ensuring authenticity and preventing unauthorized or competitive interference. The seller's identity is verified through JWT authentication.

Responses undergo moderation checks to ensure professional tone and policy compliance. When buyers edit their original reviews, associated seller responses are automatically soft-deleted to maintain contextual accuracy, requiring sellers to submit fresh responses to edited content.

Seller responses serve multiple business purposes: they demonstrate seller engagement and customer service quality, provide additional product information that may help other buyers make informed decisions, and show how sellers handle both positive and negative feedback. The visibility of seller responses contributes to marketplace transparency and trust.

This entity corresponds to the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses table in the Prisma schema and supports the marketplace's commitment to fostering constructive seller-buyer communication and transparency in the review ecosystem.

page.description:
Page number for pagination.

Specifies which page of results to retrieve in the paginated response. Page numbering starts at 1 for the first page.

Defaults to 1 if not specified. Must be a positive integer.

limit.description:
Number of items per page.

Controls how many review images are returned in a single page of results. This allows clients to adjust the response size based on their display requirements.

Defaults to a reasonable value (typically 20-50) if not specified. Maximum limit is enforced to prevent excessive data transfer and maintain performance.

oneOf.description:
Sort order for the review images.

Determines how review images are ordered in the result set. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

Supported values:
- 'created_at': Sort by upload date, oldest first
- '-created_at': Sort by upload date, newest first
- 'display_order': Sort by display sequence, lowest first
- '-display_order': Sort by display sequence, highest first

Defaults to 'display_order' if not specified to show images in their intended presentation order.

Sort order for the review images.

Determines how review images are ordered in the result set. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

Supported values:
- 'created_at': Sort by upload date, oldest first
- '-created_at': Sort by upload date, newest first
- 'display_order': Sort by display sequence, lowest first
- '-display_order': Sort by display sequence, highest first

Defaults to 'display_order' if not specified to show images in their intended presentation order.

Sort order for the review images.

Determines how review images are ordered in the result set. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

Supported values:
- 'created_at': Sort by upload date, oldest first
- '-created_at': Sort by upload date, newest first
- 'display_order': Sort by display sequence, lowest first
- '-display_order': Sort by display sequence, highest first

Defaults to 'display_order' if not specified to show images in their intended presentation order.

Sort order for the review images.

Determines how review images are ordered in the result set. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

Supported values:
- 'created_at': Sort by upload date, oldest first
- '-created_at': Sort by upload date, newest first
- 'display_order': Sort by display sequence, lowest first
- '-display_order': Sort by display sequence, highest first

Defaults to 'display_order' if not specified to show images in their intended presentation order.

sort.description:
Sort order for the review images.

Determines how review images are ordered in the result set. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

Supported values:
- 'created_at': Sort by upload date, oldest first
- '-created_at': Sort by upload date, newest first
- 'display_order': Sort by display sequence, lowest first
- '-display_order': Sort by display sequence, highest first

Defaults to 'display_order' if not specified to show images in their intended presentation order.

search.description:
Search term for filtering review images.

Optional text search that filters images based on associated metadata such as image names or descriptions. Uses platform's full-text search capabilities to match relevant images.

IShoppingMallReviewImage.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and filtering review images.

This DTO defines the query parameters used to retrieve a filtered, paginated list of review images associated with a specific product review. It supports searching, sorting, and pagination to provide flexible image browsing capabilities.

Used in conjunction with the reviewId path parameter to scope the search to a specific review's images. All parameters are optional, with sensible defaults applied when not specified.

IShoppingMallReviewImage.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a review image for lightweight display in lists and references.

Provides essential image information for product review displays, including all image size variants and ordering. Used when embedding review images within review summaries or when listing multiple review images efficiently.

This summary excludes detailed metadata but includes the foreign key relationship to the parent review and the creation timestamp for temporal ordering. It includes all necessary URLs for responsive image rendering across different display contexts (thumbnail for lists, medium for lightbox, full-size for detail views).

Optimized for performance in list views where multiple review images are shown simultaneously, while providing complete image rendering capabilities and relationship context.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the review image.

Primary key that uniquely identifies this review image record in the system. Generated automatically upon image upload and used for image retrieval and management operations.

Corresponds to the id column in the shopping_mall_review_images Prisma table.

shopping_mall_review_id.description:
Review that this image belongs to.

Foreign key establishing the relationship between this image and the customer review it illustrates. References shopping_mall_reviews.id in the Prisma schema.

This relationship enables grouping all images belonging to a single review and ensures referential integrity between reviews and their visual evidence. When a review is deleted, all associated images are also removed to maintain data consistency.

Corresponds to the shopping_mall_review_id column in the shopping_mall_review_images Prisma table.

image_url.description:
URL path to the uploaded review image.

Points to the original high-resolution image stored in the platform's media storage. This is the full-quality version uploaded by the buyer during review submission.

Used to display the review image at maximum quality in detail views and full-screen galleries. Corresponds to the image_url column in the shopping_mall_review_images Prisma table.

thumbnail_url.description:
URL path to the generated thumbnail version.

Size 200x200 pixels for efficient display in review lists and compact gallery views. Automatically generated from the original image upon upload to optimize loading performance.

Used in contexts where multiple review images need to be displayed simultaneously without consuming excessive bandwidth. Corresponds to the thumbnail_url column in the shopping_mall_review_images Prisma table.

medium_url.description:
URL path to the medium-sized version.

Size 800x800 pixels for lightbox preview displays and intermediate zoom levels. Provides a balance between image quality and loading performance for modal and overlay presentations.

Used when buyers click to enlarge review images but before loading the full high-resolution version. Corresponds to the medium_url column in the shopping_mall_review_images Prisma table.

display_order.description:
Display position order within the review's image gallery.

Lower numbers appear first in the image sequence. Allows buyers to control which images are shown first when multiple images are attached to a single review.

The first image (display_order: 0) typically serves as the primary thumbnail for the review. Corresponds to the display_order column in the shopping_mall_review_images Prisma table.

created_at.description:
Image upload timestamp.

Recorded when buyer uploads the image during review submission or editing. This ISO 8601 formatted datetime indicates the exact moment the image was added to the review.

Provides temporal context for when visual evidence was captured and uploaded, which can be relevant for time-sensitive product quality assessments or tracking buyer engagement patterns.

Corresponds to the created_at column in the shopping_mall_review_images Prisma table.

response_body.description:
Seller response text content.

Contains the seller's reply to buyer feedback including explanations, apologies, or solutions offered. This field contains the seller's written reply addressing the customer's feedback, concerns, or praise expressed in the product review.

The response should be professional, courteous, and directly address the specific points raised in the customer's review. Sellers should use this text to thank customers for positive reviews, address concerns raised in negative reviews, provide additional product information, clarify misunderstandings, or offer solutions to problems mentioned in reviews.

Minimum 10 characters, maximum 2000 characters. The system validates response text for appropriate length and content quality to maintain professional marketplace standards. Responses that violate community guidelines or contain inappropriate content may be rejected or removed.

Corresponds to the response_body column in the shopping_mall_review_seller_responses Prisma table.

IShoppingMallReviewSellerResponse.ICreat.description:
Request body for creating a seller response to a product review.

This DTO contains the minimal required information for sellers to post responses to customer reviews on their products. The seller's identity is automatically extracted from the JWT authentication token, ensuring that only authenticated sellers can create responses and preventing unauthorized or fraudulent responses.

The system validates that the authenticated seller owns the product associated with the review before allowing response creation. It also checks that no existing response already exists for the target review, enforcing the one-response-per-review business rule.

Once created, the seller response becomes immediately visible alongside the review, providing transparency to potential buyers about how sellers engage with customer feedback. The creation timestamp and moderation status are automatically set by the system.

Security considerations: The shopping_mall_seller_id field is never accepted in the request body as it comes exclusively from the authentication context. The shopping_mall_review_id is provided in the URL path parameter, not in the request body. Rate limiting may apply to prevent response spam.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the helpfulness vote record.

This UUID serves as the primary key for the vote in the shopping_mall_review_helpfulness_votes table. It is automatically generated by the system upon vote creation and remains immutable throughout the vote's lifecycle.

shopping_mall_review_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the product review that this vote is associated with.

This field links the vote to its parent review in the shopping_mall_reviews table. It establishes the relationship between the helpfulness vote and the specific review being assessed, enabling aggregation of helpfulness statistics per review.

shopping_mall_buyer_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the authenticated buyer who submitted this helpfulness vote.

This field identifies which buyer cast the vote, linking to the shopping_mall_buyers table. It enforces the business rule that each buyer can only vote once per review and enables tracking of voting patterns for fraud detection.

is_helpful.description:
Boolean flag indicating whether the buyer found the review helpful.

When true, the vote indicates the review was helpful to the buyer. When false, it indicates the review was not helpful. This binary assessment contributes to the overall helpfulness score displayed to other buyers, helping them identify the most valuable reviews.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the helpfulness vote was originally submitted.

This field records the exact date and time when the buyer first cast their vote on the review. It is automatically set by the system upon vote creation and remains immutable. The timestamp is stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone information for accurate temporal tracking across regions.

IShoppingMallReviewHelpfulnessVote.description:
Complete helpfulness vote record for a product review in the shopping mall marketplace.

Represents a buyer's assessment of whether a specific product review was helpful to them. Each vote contributes to the review's overall helpfulness statistics that guide other buyers in identifying the most valuable reviews. The system enforces one vote per buyer per review to maintain voting integrity.

Votes are permanently associated with the buyer who submitted them and the review they assessed. The is_helpful boolean captures the binary helpful/not helpful assessment. Timestamps track initial submission to enable vote tracking and analytics.

This entity integrates with the shopping_mall_review_helpfulness_votes table as defined in the Prisma schema, maintaining referential integrity with both the reviews and buyers tables through foreign key constraints.

page.description:
Page number for pagination.

Specifies which page of results to retrieve in the paginated response. Page numbering starts at 1.

Used to navigate through large result sets efficiently without loading all records at once.

limit.description:
Number of records per page.

Controls how many helpfulness vote records are returned in a single page. Must be between 1 and 100 to prevent excessive data transfer.

Higher limits reduce the number of requests needed but increase response payload size.

is_helpful.description:
Filter votes by helpfulness type.

When true, returns only positive votes (found helpful). When false, returns only negative votes (not helpful). When null or omitted, returns all votes regardless of type.

Enables analysis of vote distribution and identification of controversial reviews with mixed feedback.

shopping_mall_buyer_id.description:
Filter votes by specific buyer.

When provided, returns only votes submitted by the specified buyer. Useful for viewing a buyer's voting history or identifying voter behavior patterns.

When null or omitted, returns votes from all buyers who voted on the review.

from_created_at.description:
Filter votes created on or after this timestamp.

Enables time-range filtering to analyze voting patterns during specific periods. Only votes with created_at greater than or equal to this value are included.

Useful for tracking vote accumulation over time or identifying sudden voting activity spikes.

to_created_at.description:
Filter votes created on or before this timestamp.
